preservedResponsibilities: Original complete CXPathAPI/CXPathObject/CNodeList owners use the pinned native libxml2 XPath engine, generated SDK contracts, actual document identity and shared native result lifetime. Namespace insertion is first-wins, evaluation copies namespace/extension references and global generic-error reset remains at its original source location. Source domtest testXXPathAPI/testXXPathObject assertions run through the production context/service manager; actual Chromium main and DOM-free Worker evaluate/count/select with identical native root identity. Compiler-generated C accessors and bounded varargs formatting expose actual native fields, not guessed layouts or an alternate XPath evaluator. Shared-pointer control-block and synchronous mutex execution are explicit language lowering. Native allocation-failure/undefined inputs/float-to-integer overflow, successful custom extension results, native shared-memory concurrency, real URI providers, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unqualified.
Original native shared-result last-owner xmlXPathFreeObject responsibility is lowered explicitly; no browser API, node/value evaluator or allocator is substituted.
omittedResponsibilities: Physical C++ std::shared_ptr ABI, allocator exceptions and native thread-safe control block implementation remain unqualified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The original shared_ptr<xmlXPathObject> ownership spans xpathapi, xpathobject and nodelist. Its host-language control block is a cohesive core lifetime binding shared by those original owners; separate placement avoids an eager module initialization cycle and retains one actual native result/deleter.
